ICICI Prudential, Bharti Life deal faces conflict-of-interest resolution

ICICI Bank and Prudential have signed an undertaking to address potential conflicts of interest related to Prudential's acquisition of Bharti Life. This move comes as ICICI Prudential Life seeks investor status for Prudential following the deal. The agreement aims to resolve concerns ahead of the finalization of the Bharti Life transaction.
